input_file: Downloads/public_emdat_2026-10-26.xlsx (EM-DAT public table, version 2026-10-23, file created 2026-10-26)
columns_note: Free-text columns (location, event name, admin units) were not kept: the source file has encoding errors in place names (for example 'Quinind?').
damage_note: Damage columns are in thousand US$ and are blank for most events; the adjusted column is in current-year US$ per EM-DAT's CPI. Sums are not reported because blanks are not zeros.
licence_note: Non-commercial use only per the EM-DAT page; derived numbers must not be published without reading the Terms of Use. The file was supplied by the editor from his emdat.be registration.
coverage_note: The file holds 17,104 records; the earliest Start Year in it is 2000, so the requested 1990 to 2024 filter dropped only records from 2025 and 2026 (and none before 1990). The public table supplied appears to start in 2000; the brief's 1900-present range does not hold for this file. Whether a full-history export exists was not checked.
